update_overrides.source_notes: DELETE — 'Dolphin Qatar–UAE Natural Gas Pipeline' is unsupportable for Ruwais LNG. Searched ADNOC Gas primary releases + trade press: Ruwais LNG feed gas comes from the Habshan complex via a NEW dedicated transmission pipeline (Jan-2025 $514M China Petroleum Pipeline Engineering Co contract; 'transmission pipelines ... will connect the Habshan Complex with the Ruwais LNG facility' — adnocgas.ae/en/news-and-media/press-releases/2025/2-1-billion-contract-award and offshore-energy.biz/cnpc-unit-and-petrofac-among-winners-of-2-1b-infrastructure-contracts-for-adnocs-ruwais-lng). The Dolphin line is the unrelated Qatar North Field import pipeline (contracts expire 2032); no source connects Dolphin as Ruwais LNG's feed/connection. The new Habshan→Ruwais feedgas line has no canonical named-pipeline entity to substitute, so no CHANGE is stageable — recommend clearing the cell. Pipelines [ref] is already blank (no orphan ref).
